# `scripts/gadget_pkdgrav3_compare/compare_vpot.py`

Source: [compare_vpot.py](../../../../scripts/gadget_pkdgrav3_compare/compare_vpot.py)

compare\_vpot.py: halo-by-halo comparison of the pipeline's mean particle potential around halos (.vpot columns
phi\_&lt;R&gt; of out\_&lt;snap&gt;\_vahc.fits.gz, vahc\_fast.py) between the Gadget-4 and the pkdgrav3 run of the same ICs.

Host halos (pid = -1) are matched as in compare\_halos.py (mutual nearest centres within 0.5 Rvir\_gadget,
|log10 Mvir ratio| &lt; 0.5). Each code's phi\_&lt;R&gt; uses its own halo centre and radius (rs, R200b, Rvir, ...) and
its own particles; the radii in Mpc/h (R2Mpch, R3Mpch, R5Mpch) are the same for both.
Per output and Mvir\_gadget bin, for every radius: median and 16/84 percentiles of phi\_pkd / phi\_gadget and of
phi\_pkd - phi\_gadget in (km/s)^2; with --particles (compare\_potential.py's particles.csv) also the difference after
removing the snapshot's zero-point offset (median of phi\_pkd - phi\_gadget over all particles; every 5th output).

Usage: compare\_vpot.py &lt;gadget compressed dir&gt; &lt;pkd compressed dir&gt; &lt;out.csv&gt; [--box 200] [--particles csv]
Reads only the FITS files (fitsio); runs on the Mac on copies of out\_\*\_{basic,vahc}.fits.gz.

## Contents

- [`read`](#read) - Halos of output `i` in directory `d` with their .vpot potentials, or None if the FITS files are missing.
- [`pct`](#pct) - Median, 16th and 84th percentiles of the finite values (NaNs if fewer than 5).
- [`main`](#main) - Command line (see `--help`): compare the per-halo potentials (.vpot) of matched Gadget-4 and pkdgrav3 halos per mass bin and radius; writes `out_csv`.

## read

```python
read(d, i)
```

Halos of output `i` in directory `d` with their .vpot potentials, or None if the FITS files are missing.

Returns a dict of x, y, z, rvir, mvir, a and one array per radius in `RADII` (phi\_&lt;radius&gt;, NaN for halos
without a value), aligned with the basic table.

## pct

```python
pct(x)
```

Median, 16th and 84th percentiles of the finite values (NaNs if fewer than 5).

## main

```python
main()
```

Command line (see `--help`): compare the per-halo potentials (.vpot) of matched Gadget-4 and pkdgrav3
halos per mass bin and radius; writes `out_csv`.
